}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== {{See also|List of SBCs|Banana Pi BPI R4 (WiFi 7)}}
===Specifications=== :;Banana Pi RPI R4 board *CPU: [[MediaTek]] MT7988AV (''Filogic 880'') :Quad-Core ARM (Cortex-A73) @1.8GHz *System Memory: 8GB (DDR4) RAM *Storage: 8GB (eMMC), 256MB (SPI NAND) Flash, :MicroSD Card slot, M.2 2280 (Key M) for NVMe SSD *Networking: 4x 2.5GbE (RJ45) ports (1x WAN, 3x LAN) :• [[MaxLinear]] MxL86252C switch :2x 10GbE SFP cages (1x 10GbE SFP, 1x 2.5GbE PHY) :• AEON (Aeonsemi) AS21010P controllers <!-- *WLAN: 802.11abgn/ac/ax/be 2.4/5/6GHz (PCIe 3.0) :MT7996AV (4T4R)/MT7975N (2.4GHz)/MT7977BN (5GHz)/MT7977AN (6GHz) :MT7995 (2T2R/3T3R)/MT7976C (2.4/5GHz)/MT7977IA (6GHz) • BE14000 [https://min.news/zh-hant/digital/347e334647e4344b009db10f8e551a80.html Eagle D-Chip] *Networking: 2x 10GbE SFP+ cages multiplexed with adjacent 10GbE RJ45 jacks :Implemented through Aeonsemi AS21010P controllers :4x 2.5 Gbps Ethernet RJ45 ports; note: MaxLinear MxL86252C switch used :Gigabit Ethernet RJ45 port, Gigabit Ethernet via FPC connector --> *USB: 1x USB 3.2, 1x USB 2.0 (Host) port *Expansion: M.2 (Key-B) slot w/ USB 3.2 interface :for 5G or 4G LTE connectivity + 3x nanoSIM slots :M.2 (Key-M) slot w/ 1-lane PCIe 3.0 for NVMe SSD :2x Mini PCIe slots w/ 2-lane PCIe 3.0 for [[Banana Pi BPI R4 (WiFi 7)|Wi-Fi 7]] NIC :26-pin GPIO header for expansion *Power Supply: 12V/5.2A or 19V/3.2A via DC jack <!-- 5.5/2.1mm --> :20V DC input via header, 5V/12V output header :Optional PoE module (RT5400)
